patch_description: Add a deterministic strict-improvement polishing stage after each long survivor refinement. Annealing is effective at discovering favorable hull and orientation structures, but it leaves small coordinate-scale opportunities because the nonsmooth minimum-area objective changes its active triangle frequently. The new pass identifies vertices occurring in the lowest-area triangles and probes cardinal, diagonal, centroid-radial, and tangential directions. It accepts only a genuine primary-objective improvement, so it cannot degrade any survivor and has a small evaluation cost relative to the existing annealing budget. The stencil radius decreases geometrically, providing a reproducible local maximin refinement near the final configuration.
